description: JR真鶴駅輸送人員 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 真鶴町. 資料：JR東日本 人員については１日平均を年間総日数で積算しているため、合計の乗車人員と必ずしも一致していません。. Coverage: 真鶴町. The portal files it under the publisher 真鶴町. Its tags are 交通, 真鶴駅, 輸送. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2026-02-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
